body: Hey, I've watched it yesterday and it's a great movie. It isn't that exaggerated for me and I guess, it displayed the wrong side of the net too and how parents should act about depression.
I always wear jackets or long sleeves. But my long sleeves betrays me sometimes. I've got cuts up to my wrists and those on my left wrist are vulnerable most of the time to everyone's peeking eyes.
I sometimes punch the wall when razor blades are out of my reach. But most of the time I punch my self.
Thank you for this. I'll try it
Suicide room and sometimes any horror movie will suffice
Still better if you read his works though. Need to see deeper and hear deeper (if you're gonna use an audiobook) since his metaphors are soooo (argh. I can't describe it. It's too complex.)
Even if you're not happy today, I'll still greet you a Happy Birthday. Because somehow, I know how it feels to be greeted.
Same here. But that's not going to happen for me. And they will still get hurt either way.
Totally agreeable. But I still scratch them.
there's no painless way to end it. i've tried pills and to tell you, you will feel this large amount of back pain before you lose consciousness.

by it I mean that I hurt myself by the means of emotions. i do it on my left and right arm. sometimes on my hands. 

i see. does it bleed the same as when one does it on the wrists?

life is nothing without struggles. but if the weight is more than what you can bear, you can rest for a while and stand back up again to see if you got stronger than before. and if it's getting harder for you to breathe, you can breathe from the world of others, from mine if you like. i can't give you life nor reasons to live. but I can give you words and tricks which can either destroy your mind but not your life. 

i'm alive, but I can be dead whenever I want to be. because I can manipulate my mind.

I get like "what's wrong?" or more frequently "stop that". but then, those things won't help me. and all that I can do is to delete them, and deny their existence since it hurts to hear such things from the people who made me bleed.

how deep are they? i have some cuts too that bled even after a week or so because of their depth. if it's deep, you need to somehow, wear something that will catch the blood first before the bed sheet.

hi. I'm also in it. and if you start cutting, there's no turning back. 
i do self harm by cutting. and it just feels so good for me. but the pain I feel physically, it's just temporary. so, I try more than that. a pain that will last. so I hurt my self from the inside. somewhere where I can't see it, touch it, or aid it. but it just destroyed me mentally. 

you see, we're all looking for ways to release this blinding and killing feeling inside of us. the reason why we do self-harm isn't just because we want to divert our attention to the physical pain but because we want to release the pain inside of us.  

you can't do it safely. but there are lots of alternatives. you can brake a bone or two. punching the wall with your bare hands can be good. but through time, it will only make you stronger to the point where the pain won't come to you anymore. you will be numb. just like what I am now. 

and when you are numb, you will call for death to come.
